policy: Diagnostic only. All fit/select rows in two QSO slices and the background; no training S/N cut or row cap. Development uses explicit role-3 rows permanently excluded from final assessment; role 2 is untouched. Identical warm starts and fixed pilot nuisance terms isolate covariance-update effects in the complete scorer. No production promotion or rejection tuning. Inspect every 20 iterations, stop at 60 or four hours (finish current E step). Inconclusive is an allowed outcome.
